items.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong- Gator & Ben interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 8, 2024

ctx.x: Yeah. Pizza. And then yeah, I went to school in Hartford, Connecticut, you know played in kind of the northeast, New England area. Never full time as my full-on profession. And you know about a year after school I was still working in New Haven, going to New York on the weekends to play and zipping back to Connecticut to work and kind of doing the whole back and forth. And it was fun, it was draining, it was a lot but it was nice to finally get a random phone call from Jeremy, you know, “Hey I don’t know if you…

I can tell that from the three of us we tried out two different drummers before that and we were like okay, it’s not our old drummer like chemistry might take some time to build back up. And we were at Greg’s parents house in Long Island and Gator came in. I think we were 30 seconds to a minute into the first song, which I believe was “Time to Ride” and the three of us without even really looking at each other just shared the understanding like this is — we’re good. Like we have a future now. It was almost…
That’s really curious that it became apparent so quickly. Can you be specific why?
